chunks.chunk_text: Source status: Official BIS public information.

Official source: https://www.bis.gov.in/product-certification/product-certification-process/ The current BIS page lists official material for: - Scheme-I of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018 — product certification for use of the ISI mark. - Guidelines for Grant of Licence. - Additional Guidelines for Scheme-I. - Guidelines for dealing with product non-conformity. - Guidelines for dealing with unsatisfactory performance. - Guidelines for change in scope of licence. - Guidelines for renewal of licence. - Guidelines for retesting of samples. - Guidelines for factory surveillance. - Guidelines for market surveillance. - Guidelines for utilisation of Cluster Based Test Facility (CBTF) by MSMEs. - Scheme-IV of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018 and related guidance.

chunks.section: BIS Hallmarking & HUID — Initial Ingestion Notes
chunks.chunk_text: Source status: Official BIS public information.

https://www.bis.gov.in/hallmarking-overview/hallmarking-faqs/hallmarking-faq/ Current official FAQ facts to index: - HUID means Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) number. - HUID is a six-digit alphanumeric number and is unique for each hallmarked item. - Consumers can verify HUID using the BIS Care App's "Verify HUID" feature. - BIS states that, since the introduction of HUID on 1 July 2021, hallmark on gold jewellery consists of three marks: BIS logo, purity of the article in caratage and fineness, and six-digit alphanumeric HUID number.

https://www.bis.gov.in/hallmarking-overview/consumer-protection/?lang=en BIS states that: - Consumers can have jewellery/sample tested at BIS Recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centres on a chargeable basis. - BIS provides guidance concerning testing and compensation in cases where hallmarked jewellery is found to have lower purity than declared. - HUID authenticity can be checked through the BIS Care App.
Keep exact source URLs and retrieval dates. Do not add purity grades, fees, legal interpretations, or procedures unless supported by the current official source.

chunks.section: BIS Consumer / FAQ — Initial Ingestion Notes
chunks.chunk_text: Source status: Official BIS public information.

https://www.bis.gov.in/bis-apps/?lang=en Relevant capabilities listed by BIS include: - Verify Licence Details for products bearing a BIS mark. - Verify HUID for hallmarked jewellery. - Know Your Standards information, licences and laboratories. - Locations of BIS laboratories and offices. - Access to certification-related information.

https://www.bis.gov.in/hallmarking-overview/consumer-protection/?lang=en Relevant official guidance includes: - consumer testing of hallmarked/unhallmarked articles through BIS Recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centres; - HUID verification using BIS Care App; - guidance concerning compensation when hallmarked jewellery is found to have lower purity than marked.
